effect.name: Drop Shadow
effect.description: Casts an offset shadow of the sprite behind itself, in one draw and one object. Lifts HUD cards and text off the background - the same trick the score panel in this repo uses, but free.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Offset X
parameter.description: How far right the shadow falls, in texels.

parameter.name: Offset Y
parameter.description: How far down the shadow falls, in texels.

parameter.name: Soften
parameter.description: Blurs the shadow by averaging four extra taps this far out, in texels. 0 keeps it hard edged, which is the right answer for pixel art.
